aiResearchSummary.text: Nobell Foods is researching plant-based production of animal proteins. Compositions and methods for expressing genes of interest in host cells enable stabilized RNA and increased protein expression in plant cells. Host cells comprising a recombinant casein protein and a recombinant kinase and recombinant fusion proteins for producing milk proteins in plants support milk protein production per acre and cheese food compositions. Food products comprising plant-expressed milk proteins extend this work to meat substitute compositions.
